description: This file defines a static class 'MdDomMsgs' containing localized message resources and error message generators for the MigraDoc Document Object Model, including general and DdlReader-specific messages.

classes.name: MdDomMsgs
classes.description: A static class providing localized message strings and error message generators for MigraDoc DocumentObjectModel.

methods.name: StyleExpected
methods.description: Generates a message indicating a type 'Style' was expected but a different type was provided.

methods.name: BaseStyleRequired
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a base style name must be defined.

methods.name: EmptyBaseStyle
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that setting an empty base style is invalid.

methods.name: InvalidFieldFormat
methods.description: Returns a message indicating an invalid numeric field format.

methods.name: InvalidInfoFieldName
methods.description: Returns a message indicating an invalid 'Name' property value of 'InfoField'.

methods.name: UndefinedBaseStyle
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the base style of a style is undefined.
